method: PURE v4FusDenseNet full-network, no hybrid teacher/external encoder. Class-paired batches (50natural+2perclass,64unique perbatch), sqrt(p/q)CE importance, training-only fused588->128contrastive projection and shared-backbone exact classifier-dropout RDrop.
selection: Accuracy AND disgust recall strictly improve over pure baseline on fixed3970validation faces; macro/disgustF1 cannot decline. Max .4accuracy+.4macroF1+.2disgustF1, student/EMA. Early stopping tracks unconstrained objective progress, not eligibility.
test: At most ONE frozen qualifying candidate, single-view only, full6561retainedhistorically inspected test. Gate accuracy/macroF1/disgustF1 improve, disgustrecall no lower than PUREbaseline. Former hybrid is separately reported; userexplicitlyrequests puredefault, not a hidden hybrid replacement. No alternate test search.
deployment: Install an improved pure model if it passes its pure baseline gate; disclose its comparison to former59.26%hybrid even if lower. Do not relabel the hybrid as pure. Preserve all originals.
limitations: Repeatedly reused validation and historically inspected test, not fresh/identity-disjoint confirmation. Auxiliary projection/batch/loss choices are project training extensions; no exact original-author reproduction.
